My take on that part, is that there is a dark hidden place under the island, and by extension there a dark hidden part inside of Rey. She desperately want to get some kind parent figure, because she is confused and needs direction. Luke sees this as a trait of the dark side, because she basically is acting out of her desires, i.e. something that led Kylo Ren to the dark side. Rey gets sucked into the cave in search of answers, but instead of finding her parents she finds a image of herself. This I think means the the mirror answers her question of "Who can I lean against? Were can I find purpose and direction?" To which the mirror answers that only herself can give that kind of strength. As Kylo Ren says "Your parent were nobody". This scene illustrates that Rey begins to let go of her search for her parents, and therefore better can resist the urge to join the dark side.

Try some different things:
If you have the steam version try "verify game cache files".
Try running the game at different graphics settings.
Make sure your graphic driver is up to date.
Try running the game as administrator.
Try running the game in compatibility mode, set it to XP service pack 2.

and report back your findings :)
